candidate_sources.docs/host-api.md: createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.

checkpoints: Verify multiple edits within one burst reset the timer and produce exactly one store write containing the latest text after 120 ms of quiet.
Verify a later edit burst schedules and completes another save.
Verify an empty-string edit is saved.
Verify Edit is a no-op when no document is open.
Verify pending edits remain associated with the document that accepted them when switching documents, reopening the same document, closing, or disposing.
Verify departure preserves the prior synchronous persistence behavior: a pending edit is available to the destination read before Open returns and is not lost by Close or Dispose.
Verify synchronous navigation from a save listener leaves the nested navigation authoritative and does not install the superseded outer document.
Verify the departing Badge subscription is removed and status output remains filtered to the current document.
Verify Preview still uses its 40 ms trailing task and Hide cancels pending preview work.
forbidden_effects: Do not continue writing every keystroke directly to the store.
Do not save an earlier value from a burst after a later edit has been accepted.
Do not redirect pending text to whichever document is current when the timer fires.
Do not cancel or discard an accepted document edit merely because its Badge is detached.
Do not let an outer Open overwrite navigation performed synchronously by a save callback.
Do not change Store event payloads, revision behavior, listener ordering, document/status output shapes, or public interfaces.
Do not change search-preview timing, cancellation, or publication behavior.
Do not merge Badge subscription ownership with BufferBank ownership.
lifecycle_identity: A document buffer is identified by document ID and is retained in BufferBank independently of any current Badge.
A Badge represents the current document view and owns only that view's live store subscription.
An accepted edit belongs to the current Badge's captured document buffer, even if navigation occurs before consumption.
Workspace generation identifies the currently authoritative Open or Close operation; synchronous nested navigation supersedes an older request.
A Trailing burst ends when its latest pending value is consumed after the quiet interval or explicitly flushed during departure.

obligations.text: Workspace.Edit must capture the current Badge and push the accepted text into that Badge's reusable document buffer; it must remain a no-op when there is no current Badge.
Each document buffer must use Trailing with a 120 ms delay so repeated edits reset the quiet interval and only the latest text in that burst is written.
After a burst is consumed, the Trailing task must remain reusable so subsequent bursts also save, including an empty-string value.
Pending text must retain the document ID captured by the BufferBank entry and must not be reassigned according to later workspace state.

When retiring a Badge, Workspace must revoke current ownership, detach the captured subscription, clear the document presentation, and preserve accepted pending text by flushing its captured buffer before retirement completes.

Because flushing can synchronously invoke store listeners that navigate, an outer Open must revalidate its generation after retirement and must not install a destination when a nested navigation has superseded it.
Trailing.Flush must retire its pending handle and value before invoking callback-capable save work, preventing duplicate nested consumption while allowing later pushes to form a new burst.

The implementation must preserve existing Store reads/writes, revision and event payload semantics, current-document status filtering, subscription cleanup, document output behavior, and the public Workspace interfaces.
Preview must remain outside the change: Query continues to use its existing 40 ms trailing task and Hide continues to cancel it.

ordering_barriers: At Edit acceptance, resolve the current Badge and its buffer before navigation can change workspace state.
On departure, set current to nil before callback-capable persistence so reentrant operations cannot act through the departing Badge.
Detach the departing Badge and publish the cleared document state before flushing its buffer.
In Trailing.Flush, cancel/retire the timer and clear pending state before invoking the save callback.
After retirement and any resulting synchronous navigation, compare the captured Open request generation with the current generation before creating a destination Badge or rendering its document.
Store.Write must continue to update the record and revision before notifying subscribed listeners.
preservation: Public methods remain createWorkspace-equivalent Open, Edit, Close, Dispose behavior through the existing Go types, and Preview retains Query and Hide.
BufferBank continues to provide one reusable Trailing buffer per document ID.
Badge subscriptions continue to emit status only when the event ID equals the Badge's document ID.
Opening continues to render the selected document using the current store value; retirement continues to output a nil document.
Store writes retain id, text, and revision fields and synchronous listener notification.
Closing and disposing continue to retire the current view and its subscription.
Search preview retains its distinct 40 ms quiet interval and cancellation behavior.
scope: Change only the workspace draft editor's edit persistence path and the lifecycle handling needed to preserve editor behavior while introducing delayed saves.
Use the existing Trailing utility and separate BufferBank service in src/workflow.go.
Include Open, Close, and Dispose boundaries where accepted delayed edits could otherwise be lost or where saving can synchronously navigate.
Exclude the adjacent search preview from behavioral changes.

supporting_evidence.quote: The workspace draft editor currently writes to the store on every keystroke.

interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save.

triggers: Workspace.Edit(text) while a Badge is current.
